name: Clocked Decide Example - Incident Priority
description: Make decisions about incident priority using the Clocked Decide API

parameters.state: The entire finance team loses its VPN connection every five minutes. Payroll must be submitted today. There is no workaround. The manager approved an emergency network change.
parameters.instructions: Urgent means a team is blocked against a same-day business deadline without a workaround. Count approval only when it is explicitly stated.

approved.instructions: Has the manager approved the emergency change?

route.instructions: Which team should own the issue?

criteria.deadline: A business deadline is at risk today.
criteria.data_loss: Files or records have been lost.

criteria: Medium: one person affected with a workaround
High: a team blocked with a same-day deadline
